decision.explanation: We are decreasing the running distance because of a previous injury and the user's recognition of increasing mileage too quickly. On 2025-12-24, you experienced sharp knee pain. Subsequently, on 2025-01-22, you identified that rapid mileage increases were the root cause.  Therefore, reducing the distance to 3km will allow for a safer and more controlled return to running, incorporating glute and quad strengthening exercises.

relevant_memories.content: FUCK. Sharp pain in right knee at mile 1. Had to walk home. Limping now. This is bad.
Can't walk without pain. Mood is trash. I hate this. Why did I push so hard?
Read about 'Runner's Knee' in detail. Realized I increased mileage too fast in Week 2. Need to strengthen glutes and quads.
Started glute bridge exercises. Knee feels more stable. Learned my lesson about gradual progression.
Did glute bridges today. Knee feels stable. Going to stick to Zone 2 cardio only when I return. Learned: gradual progression prevents injury.
Planning next week: Max 3km runs, focus on form, add glute strength work. Won't make the same mistake twice.
